summary:
A single-storey Roman villa, 36 by 48 blocks, built around three open courts: a street front with a recessed fauces between four shuttered shops, an atrium roofed in a ring with a square compluvium over an impluvium, and a peristyle garden court ringed by a white quartz colonnade, with the tablinum on the axis between them.
Roofs are red-tile shed bands that slope inward to the courts, leaving the compluvium open; the walls are cream plaster with a red dado over mosaic floors.
Five parts (shell, roofs, peristyle, atrium, facade) build the shell and the courts, then 18 room designers furnish the interiors in parallel.

concept_subject: A Roman villa seen from the street, low and long: a symmetrical front of cream plaster walls with a red painted dado at the base, the terracotta tile roofs sloping inward, and at the centre a recessed doorway (fauces) with a pediment of white quartz stairs and two bronze lamps on quartz posts. Four shuttered shop rooms flank it, their dark oak shutters open on counters of quartz, and a stone-paved approach runs in front. Behind the doorway the atrium is open to the sky through a square opening in the roof, with a shallow rain pool of water under it, mosaic floor in black and white, a potted plant at each side, and the tablinum facing the entrance across the atrium. Behind that, the peristyle garden court: a white colonnade of quartz columns with capitals ringing a grass court, low green hedges framing two planted beds with rose bushes and flowers, a round-free fountain basin of quartz with a water jet on a central column, and two bronze-green statues on plinths standing among the beds. Dining room with couches on three sides, bedrooms and a kitchen with a hearth, all off the courts.
concept_palette: walls smooth_quartz (cream plaster) with red_terracotta dado; columns and capitals quartz_pillar and quartz_slab; plinth and statue plinths polished_andesite; floor mosaic white_terracotta with black_terracotta border; roof tiles bricks and red_nether_bricks (eave bricks, ridge quartz_slab); doors dark_oak_door; shutters dark_oak_trapdoor; windows iron_bars; court grass_block with azalea_leaves hedges, rose_bush and cornflower; fountain quartz_block and water; statues oxidized_copper; bronze lamps lantern on quartz_pillar stubs; pots flower_pot with potted_fern and potted_azalea_bush
